output.title: Revenue by category — last 6 months
output.sql: select to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') as month, category, round(sum(net_cents) / 100.0, 2) as revenue from v_revenue_monthly where month >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date - interval '5 months' group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2
output.explanation: Invoiced revenue before tax, in dollars, by month and category.
